required_fixes: Recalibrate Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial estimator: K=12 yields bias floor ~0.13 bits at n≈333 per stratum, exceeding frozen |null_mean|<0.1 threshold. Options: (a) increase K to 24 (producer notes this gives mean 0.074 std 0.0104, passing both), (b) increase N per stratum via larger sample, or (c) adjust alpha prior. Must preserve frozen decision rule thresholds; any recalibration requires new preregistration.

Independent-noise null degenerate (null_std 0.0046 < 0.01) due to low DOM diversity (3 variants per state) and large n per stratum. If independent control is to serve as valid null for pipeline discrimination, increase variants to >=6 per state or reduce n per stratum to raise null_std>0.01 without confounding.

Document whether per-trajectory L persistence (tested) vs per-15-step regime with P(flip)=0.07 (frozen but not tested) yields different null centering, as trajectory-grouped permutation assumes L constant within trajectory.
validity_findings: Positive correlated control shows strong signal (BC 0.688 bits, p_raw 0.001, p_bonf 0.00799, Cohen d 73.1) exceeding all magnitude thresholds (BC>=0.30, gap>=0.05), confirming constructed correlation is detectable. Pipeline is NOT blind — G1 failure is estimator calibration, not blindness.

Null centering borderline: |null_mean| = 0.1297 exceeds 0.1 by 0.03 bits; null_std = 0.0094 below 0.01 by 0.0006. Both marginal. Bias floor at K=12, n≈333 is ~0.13 bits, slightly above tightened threshold from prior Laplace floor (0.3056). This is infrastructure/calibration, not scientific falsification.

Independent-noise replication correctly shows BC -0.005 (|BC|<0.05), p_raw 0.865 (>0.10), replicating prior falsification (0.004 bits). Pipeline distinguishes correlation from independent noise (G2 not triggered). Independent null_std degenerate (0.0046) is representation loss (low DOM diversity), not confound.
IID null correctly shows BC 0.0013, p 0.401, confirming null centering for truly independent S_next. Validates correlated signal is not estimator bias alone.

Baselines executed as frozen: B-DOM-SIMILARITY BC_sim 0.0 (acc 0.108), B-MARKOV-1 BC 0.0, B-MARKOV-K3 BC 0.0. Gap BC - max(sim,markov1) = 0.688 >= 0.05 satisfies director mandate. TF-IDF vocab fit TRAIN only (70/30 by trajectory_id), no site identity leakage.

Data quality passes: strata 24 (all ge3), singleton_rate 0.0, H(S_next|C) 3.302 > 0.3, |R|/N 0.018 (6 states × 2 L × 3 variants = 36 uniques), MI(DOM;Action) 0.0 bits (not tautological), leakage_validOnly 0.0.

R1 and R2 isomorphic by construction (both encode L via SHA256(L||state||variant)), so identical results expected. R3 multi_feature same. R4 numeric structural degenerate (BC -0.0038, p 0.733) as expected.
No Gate0 production SPAs required; locally-hosted Express FSM substrate_available by construction. Avoids prior Q=0 dom_bytes=0.0 trap on reused TodoMVC artifacts.

Trajectory-grouped permutation correctly preserves per-trajectory DOM frequencies within strata, resampling unit = trajectory_id, no Gaussian jitter, 95% CI via permutation percentiles, Bonferroni over max 8 tests (floor 0.001 at 1000 perms).
baseline_findings: B-DOM-SIMILARITY (TF-IDF cosine k=5, train-only vocab): BC_sim = 0.0, accuracy 0.108. Ordinary DOM text similarity carries zero predictive information beyond (URL, H_K=3, Action). Gap 0.688 satisfies >=0.05 mandate.
B-MARKOV-1 (MLE P(S_next|URL,Action) train-only): BC_markov1 = 0.0, accuracy 0.157. First-order Markov without DOM carries zero extra information beyond conditioning set. Gap 0.688 satisfies >=0.05.
B-MARKOV-K3 (history majority vote): BC_hist = 0.0, accuracy 0.152. History memory alone does not explain DOM predictive information.
B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED: null distribution as reported in primary (mean 0.1297, std 0.0094), degenerate per G4.
B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY: Not separately computed but H ceiling 3.302 indicates memorization ceiling not driving signal.
B-SITE-LEAKAGE: Action_leaky vs Action_leakageFree gap = 0.0, MI(DOM;Action) = 0.0. No href tautology.
All baselines executed with identical grouping (trajectory_id), seeds 42, Dirichlet prior alpha=1/K=12, TRAIN-only fit. No omissions.
claim_ceiling: MEASUREMENT_INVALID: pipeline gates fail borderline on null centering (|null_mean|=0.1297>0.1, null_std=0.0094<0.01), not a scientific falsification. Correlated DOM_before carries strong predictive signal (BC 0.688 bits, p=0.001, gap 0.688 over similarity/Markov baselines) exceeding all magnitude thresholds, and independent-noise correctly shows BC~0 (replicating prior 0.004-bit falsification). Bayesian DM K=12 bias floor ~0.13 bits at n≈333 slightly exceeds tightened threshold; K=24 would pass (mean 0.074, std 0.0104). No claim update to C-WEB-DYNAMICS — ceiling remains HYPOTHESIS. Physics should recalibrate estimator (K/alpha/N) before claiming SURVIVES on this FSM class; do not invest in hash-DOM regime detectors until validated.
